title: Resulting part
spec: To construct the first part, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create a loop by drawing four lines: the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0312), the third line from (0.75, 0.0312) to (0.0, 0.0312), and the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0312) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional shape. Transform the scaled sketch into a three-dimensional model by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0312 units to create a solid body. The dimensions of the resulting part are 0.75 units in length, 0.03125 units in width, and 0.03125 units in height. This part serves as the base of the cylindrical object with a rectangular cross-section and rounded edges.

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0312) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0312) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0312)
